metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2010 · Inception
metas.description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO, but his tragic past may doom the project and his team to disaster.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2014 · Interstellar
metas.description: In a dystopian future where Earth has become near-uninhabitable, a team of astronauts embark on a mission to find a new home for humanity.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2019 · Avengers: Endgame
metas.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2018 · Avengers: Infinity War
metas.description: The Avengers and their allies must be willing to sacrifice all in an attempt to defeat the powerful Thanos before his blitz of devastation and ruin puts an end to the universe.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2018 · Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Teen Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe and must join with five spider-powered individuals from other dimensions to stop a threat for all realities.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2017 · Coco
metas.description: Aspiring musician Miguel, confronted with his family's ancestral ban on music, enters the Land of the Dead to find his great-great-grandfather, a legendary singer.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2010 · Toy Story 3
metas.description: As Andy prepares to leave for college, Woody, Buzz and the gang face an uncertain future when a mix-up sends them to a daycare center full of new toys.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2019 · Klaus
metas.description: A simple act of kindness always sparks another, even in a frozen, faraway place. When Smeerensburg's new postman, Jesper, befriends toymaker Klaus, their gifts melt an age-old feud and deliver a sleigh full of holiday traditions.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2015 · Mad Max: Fury Road
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners, a psychotic worshipper and a drifter named Max.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2011 · Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
metas.description: Harry, Ron and Hermione set out on a quest to eliminate the remaining horcruxes. On the other hand, the students and teachers must unite to defend Hogwarts against Lord Voldemort and his army.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2015 · Inside Out
metas.description: After young Riley is uprooted from her Midwest life and moved to San Francisco, her emotions, Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust, and Sadness, conflict on how best to navigate a new city, house, and school.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2010 · How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: A hapless young Viking who aspires to hunt dragons becomes the unlikely friend of a young dragon himself, and learns there may be more to the creatures than he assumed.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2015 · Bajrangi Bhaijaan
metas.description: An Indian man with a magnanimous heart takes a young mute Pakistani girl back to her homeland to reunite her with her family.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2018 · Free Solo
metas.description: Alex Honnold faces the biggest challenge of his career, climbing El Capitan in Yosemite National Park. He pursues it Free Solo, which means climbing without a rope and alone.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2013 · Queen
metas.description: A Delhi girl from a traditional family sets out on a solo honeymoon after her marriage gets cancelled.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2014 · Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: A group of intergalactic criminals must pull together to stop a fanatical warrior with plans to purge the universe.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2015 · The Martian
metas.description: An astronaut stranded on Mars must rely on his ingenuity to survive and arrange a potential rescue.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2016 · Zootopia
metas.description: In a city of anthropomorphic animals, a rookie bunny cop and a cynical con artist fox must work together to uncover a conspiracy.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2014 · Song of the Sea
metas.description: Ben, a young Irish boy, and his little sister Saoirse, a girl who can turn into a seal, go on an adventure to free the fairies and save the spirit world.
